steps.title: Getting started
steps.text: Climb down the trapdoor inside the pub in Burgh de Rott.
steps.warning: For the tracking to work properly, you need to have the chat visible, game messages set to 'On', and chat timestamps on.

steps.title: Preparing for the fight
steps.text: Teleport to Meiyerditch with the Drakan's medallion.

actions.text: I managed to get some logs from the blisterwood tree.
We may be able to trust her, yes.
I'd be happy to dispatch one of the Myreque's most fearsome opponents.

steps.text: Talk to Vertida again for a bottle of holy water.
Talk to Kael Forshaw for two silver sickles.

actions.text: Do you have any sickles I could use?

steps.text: Use the medallion to teleport back to Darkmeyer.

Craft each of the logs into a staff, a polearm, and a set of stakes.
  • Bank if you need to. Keep the bottle of holy water and blisterwood weapons.
Throw the bottle of holy water at Harold.

steps.title: The battle with Vanstrom
steps.text:
Kill Vanstrom Klause.
  • Pray melee if close, mage at a distance.
  • 'Stare into the darkness!': Run to the edge and rotate camera away.
  • 'Let the blood consume you!': Run from the blood splodge.
  • 'Come, fiends, and aid your master!': Kill the minions.
  • Blood bombs: run.
  • Cloud form: Use holy water near him.
Kill the bloodveld guardians. Shriek as soon as it recharges.

steps.title: Finishing up
steps.text: Return to the basement of the pub in Burgh de Rott.
